x: The field for the two miles run was more numerous, although both Len Herbert and Derrick Burfitt were non-starters. The eventual winner was J.
Alan Bishop won the 880 yards with Jim Kennedy second, and Len Adams was third in the mile. Scores were: Herne Hill, 86 points; Bels., 77; Hercules, 66.
Harry Greene 1st in the Inter Schools race for the Densham Cup. Ken England and Jim Kennedy on their recent marriages.

The 880 yards saw Archie Bedford and Jim Kennedy running for us but up against a strong Walton trio, which included Willie Nankeville, the A.A.A. mile champion, we had to be content with 4th place through Bedford, whereas Walton scored a “ maximum ” of 8 points for this race.

Archie Bedford finished third in the individual race with Vern Blowfield in fifth place, and then came Jimmy Wood 13th with Len Bishop 16th, and the latter just beat Tom Richards, the well known marathon runner. Others to finish were—Ken Cuff, 36th; J.
McLean was second off 140, with J.
Marshall was also 3rd in the 220 yds., and Bob Wolton won the 440 in 53 secs., and was also 3rd in the 880 yds. J.
Cronk, off 70 yds., score a good win in the fast time of 1 min. 54.7 secs. J.
